title: sprites.json bbox parse checks structure but not value ranges; comment overclaims 'any malformation fails the sheet'
detail: Parse validates only type/count. Negative x/y or boxes beyond the 256px canvas load fine and reach DrawTexturePro's source rect (line 142); only w/h<=0 are guarded downstream (line 138). Reachable solely by hand-editing the committed sidecar, so note-level.
recommended_fix: In sprites_parse_boxes reject entries where any value <0, w/h <=0, or x+w/y+h exceed the 256 canvas, returning false so the sheet falls back to primitives, matching the line-70 comment.
